normalIntro.cn: slap 是平掌碰到表面的那一刻。

abstract.en: A slap is a short, sharp sentence of the hand.

abstract.cn: 匆忙把东西胡乱拼起，然后称之为完成。

core.en: A flat hand meeting a surface in one quick blow.

branches.en: An open hand strikes a mosquito.

items.example: His slapdash work showed little care.

items.example: The decision was a slap in the face.

items.exampleCN: 她立刻否定了这个想法。

definition_en: to rest with your eyes closed and mind unaware, or the state of this rest
core_image: 婴儿在摇篮里熟睡
scene: 婴儿在摇篮里安静地睡着了。The baby slept peacefully in the cradle.
sceneCN: 这里 sleep 是「睡觉」（第 1 个义项）；句意：婴儿在摇篮里安静地睡着了。

senses.title: Rest with eyes closed
senses.definition: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind not aware of the world
senses.definitionCN: 闭眼休息、头脑不感知外界
senses.example: The baby slept peacefully in the cradle.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿在摇篮里安静地睡着了。
senses.why: This is the basic nightly action.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的夜间行为。

senses.title: The state of resting
senses.definition: the natural state of rest in which you are not awake
senses.definitionCN: 未醒时自然的休息状态
senses.example: A good sleep can fix a bad mood.
senses.exampleCN: 好好睡一觉能改善坏心情。
senses.why: The noun names the whole state.
senses.whyCN: 名词指整个状态。

senses.title: Have room for guests
senses.definition: to have enough beds for a number of people
senses.definitionCN: 有足够的床位容纳若干人
senses.example: The small hotel sleeps twenty guests.
senses.exampleCN: 这家小旅馆可供二十位客人住宿。
senses.why: A building can sleep people by giving them beds.
senses.whyCN: 建筑通过提供床位让人睡下。

abstract.en: The night carries what the day cannot hold.
abstract.cn: 夜晚承载白天装不下的东西。

abstract.en: Rest is not wasted time but gathered strength.

core.en: A nightly state of rest and repair.

branches.en: The eyes close and the body quiets.
branches.cn: 眼睛闭上，身体安静下来。

branches.en: A hotel provides beds for guests.

definition_en: the part of a garment that covers the arm, or a tube that covers something
core_image: 长袖衬衫的袖口整齐地卷起
scene: 天冷了，把袖子放下来吧。It is cold, so pull your sleeves down.
sceneCN: 这里 sleeve 是「袖子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：天冷了，把袖子放下来吧。

senses.title: The arm cover
senses.definition: the part of a piece of clothing that covers all or part of the arm
senses.definitionCN: 衣物覆盖全部或部分手臂的部分
senses.example: It is cold, so pull your sleeves down.
senses.exampleCN: 天冷了，把袖子放下来吧。

senses.why: The shape of a sleeve fits tubes and covers.

senses.title: The record cover
senses.definition: a paper or card cover for a record

senses.whyCN: 封套包住唱片，就像袖子包住手臂。

senses.title: Thin and graceful

normalIntro.en: A slice is a thin piece and the act of cutting it.
normalIntro.cn: slice 是薄薄的一片，也是切出它的动作。

normal.en: She sliced some bread and put it in the toaster.
normal.cn: 她切了几片面包，放进烤面包机。

normal.en: She put a slice of bread on the plate.
normal.cn: 她把一片面包放在盘子里。

normal.en: He wants a slice of the profit.
normal.cn: 他想要一份利润。

normal.en: Slice the cake into eight pieces.
normal.cn: 把蛋糕切成八块。

normal.en: The knife made a thin slice.
normal.cn: 刀切出一片薄片。

abstract.en: A slice is a small view of a larger whole.
abstract.cn: 一片是整体的一次小小呈现。

abstract.en: Cutting evenly is a quiet kind of fairness.
abstract.cn: 切得均匀是一种安静的公平。

abstract.en: Everyone wants a slice, but someone must bake.
abstract.cn: 每个人都想分一份，但总得有人来烤。

examples.en: She sliced some bread and put it in the toaster.

dict_mnemonic.text: slice 与 slide、spice 形近；a slice of bread 是「一片面包」，a slice of life 是「生活片段」。

sensesIntro.en: Slice means a thin piece, the cutting that makes it, or a share of something.

core.en: A thin flat piece divided from a whole.
core.cn: 从整体分出的薄而平的一片。

branches.en: A flat piece lies on the plate.
branches.cn: 一片薄片躺在盘子里。

branches.cn: 刀刃分开面包。

branches.en: A profit is divided into shares.
branches.cn: 利润被分成份额。

branches.en: The cut and the cut piece belong together.
branches.cn: 切割与切下的片彼此相属。

branches.en: A physical piece stands for an abstract share.
branches.cn: 具体的片象征抽象的份额。

intro.en: Slice forms words for cutting and shares.
intro.cn: slice 构成表示切割和份额的词。

latinIntro.cn: slice 经古法语传入，并非直接来自拉丁语。

definition_en: to move smoothly over a surface, or a smooth surface for sliding
core_image: 孩子从光滑的滑梯上滑下
scene: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。The children slid down the slope one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 slide 是「滑动」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。

senses.title: Move smoothly
senses.definition: to move smoothly and easily over a surface
senses.definitionCN: 在表面上平滑轻松地移动
senses.example: The children slid down the slope one by one.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。
senses.why: This is the basic movement sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的移动义项。

senses.title: A surface for sliding
senses.definition: a smooth surface or structure for sliding down
senses.definitionCN: 供人滑下的光滑表面或结构
senses.example: The park has a long slide.
senses.exampleCN: 公园里有一座长滑梯。
senses.why: The thing you slide on takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 用来滑的物体也用同一个名称。

senses.title: A projected picture
senses.definition: a picture shown on a screen for a talk
senses.definitionCN: 讲演时投在屏幕上的图片
senses.example: The next slide shows the results.
senses.exampleCN: 下一张幻灯片显示结果。
senses.why: Images slide from one to the next in a talk.
senses.whyCN: 讲演中图像从一张滑到下一张。

intro.en: Slide is an old English verb for smooth movement.
intro.cn: slide 是英语中表示平滑移动的古老动词。

items.en: Slidan meant to slip or glide.
items.cn: slidan 意为滑倒或滑行。

items.en: The verb became sliden.
items.cn: 动词演变为 sliden。

items.en: The spelling settled as slide.
items.cn: 拼写最终定型为 slide。

items.en: The noun named a sliding surface.
items.cn: 名词指滑动的表面。

items.en: Photography gave it the sense of a projected picture.
items.cn: 摄影术赋予它「投影图片」的义项。

note.en: Slide is compared with look-alike words and words for smooth movement.
note.cn: 把 slide 与形近词以及表示平滑移动的词作比较。

entries.definition: to slide over snow on skis

normalIntro.en: To slide is to let a smooth surface carry you.
normalIntro.cn: slide 就是让光滑的表面带着你走。

normal.en: The children slid down the slope one by one.
normal.cn: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。

normal.en: The park has a long slide.
normal.cn: 公园里有一座长滑梯。

normal.en: The next slide shows the results.
normal.cn: 下一张幻灯片显示结果。

normal.en: The door slides open quietly.
normal.cn: 门悄悄滑开了。

normal.en: Do not let the chance slide away.
normal.cn: 别让机会溜走。

abstract.en: Some progress slides forward without a sound.
abstract.cn: 有些进步悄无声息地向前滑动。

abstract.en: A smooth surface hides the speed it gives.
abstract.cn: 光滑的表面掩盖了它带来的速度。

abstract.en: What slides away may still be caught.
abstract.cn: 滑走的东西也许仍能被抓住。

examples.en: The children slid down the slope one by one.
examples.cn: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。

examples.cn: 公园里有一座长滑梯。

examples.en: The next slide shows the results.
examples.cn: 下一张幻灯片显示结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: slide 与 slice 形近，注意结尾；slide show 是「幻灯片展示」，let it slide 是「顺其自然、不追究」。

root: 源自古英语 slidan（滑倒、滑行）；核心义「在光滑表面上连续移动」。

sensesIntro.en: Slide covers smooth movement, the surface you slide on, and a projected picture.
sensesIntro.cn: slide 涵盖平滑移动、供滑行的表面，以及投影图片。

core.en: Smooth movement along a surface.
core.cn: 沿表面平滑移动。

branches.en: A body travels without lifting.
branches.cn: 身体不离开表面地移动。

branches.en: A playground offers a smooth slope.
branches.cn: 游乐场提供光滑的斜坡。

branches.en: A talk moves from image to image.
branches.cn: 讲演从一张图移到下一张图。

branches.en: The motion and the surface share a name.
branches.cn: 动作与表面共用一个名称。

branches.en: Shapes and pictures both glide past.
branches.cn: 形状与图片都滑过眼前。

intro.en: Slide forms words for smooth movement and slides.
intro.cn: slide 构成表示平滑移动和滑行物的词。

latinIntro.en: Slide is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: slide 源自日耳曼语，并非拉丁语。

items.example: The box slid across the floor.
The drawer slides easily.
He slid on the wet floor.
items.exampleCN: 他在湿地板上滑了一下。

items.example: The sliding door is open.
Move the slider to the right.
The water slide was crowded.
We watched a slide show of the trip.
items.exampleCN: 我们看了旅行的幻灯片。

items.example: She slid down the hill on a board.

definition_en: small in degree, thin in build, or to treat someone without respect
core_image: 声音里一丝几乎听不出的颤抖
scene: 她的声音里有一丝轻微的颤抖。There was a slight tremble in her voice.
sceneCN: 这里 slight 是「轻微的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她的声音里有一丝轻微的颤抖。

senses.title: Small in degree
senses.definition: small in amount, degree, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 数量、程度或重要性很小
senses.example: There was a slight tremble in her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 她的声音里有一丝轻微的颤抖。
senses.why: This is the main everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常的主要义项。

senses.title: Thin in build
senses.definition: thin and not strongly built
senses.definitionCN: 瘦小且不强壮
senses.example: A slight figure waited by the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 一个瘦小的身影在门口等候。
senses.why: A small body looks slight.
senses.whyCN: 小小的身体看起来瘦弱。

senses.title: Treat without respect
senses.definition: to treat someone as if they are not important
senses.definitionCN: 把某人当作不重要的人对待
senses.example: He felt slighted by the short reply.
senses.exampleCN: 他因那简短的回覆而感到被怠慢。
senses.why: The adjective's smallness became an act of ignoring.
senses.whyCN: 形容词的「小」引申为忽视的行为。

intro.en: Slight probably came from an old word for smooth or level.
intro.cn: slight 可能来自表示光滑或平坦的古老词。

items.en: Slettr meant smooth or level.
items.cn: slettr 意为光滑或平坦。

items.en: The word appeared as slight.
items.cn: 这个词以 slight 的形式出现。

items.en: It came to mean thin or small.
items.cn: 它开始表示瘦弱或微小。

items.en: The sense of unimportant grew.
items.cn: 「不重要」的义项发展起来。

items.en: As a verb it meant to ignore or insult.
items.cn: 作动词时意为忽视或怠慢。

note.en: Slight is compared with look-alike words and words for smallness.
note.cn: 把 slight 与形近词以及表示微小的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Slight means small enough to miss, in body or in manner.
normalIntro.cn: slight 意为小到容易忽略，无论身体还是态度。

normal.en: There was a slight tremble in her voice.
normal.cn: 她的声音里有一丝轻微的颤抖。

normal.en: A slight figure waited by the gate.
normal.cn: 一个瘦小的身影在门口等候。

normal.en: He felt slighted by the short reply.
normal.cn: 他因那简短的回覆而感到被怠慢。

normal.en: The plan needs a slight change.
normal.cn: 计划需要一点小改动。

normal.en: Do not worry about a slight delay.
normal.cn: 不要为一点小延误担心。

abstract.en: A slight hurt can still leave a mark.
abstract.cn: 轻微的伤害也能留下痕迹。

abstract.en: To slight someone is to make them small in your eyes.
abstract.cn: 怠慢某人就是把他看得渺小。

abstract.en: Small differences decide large outcomes.
abstract.cn: 微小的差别决定巨大的结果。

examples.en: There was a slight tremble in her voice.
examples.cn: 她的声音里有一丝轻微的颤抖。

examples.en: The plan needs a slight change.
examples.cn: 计划需要一点小改动。

examples.en: He felt slighted by the short reply.
examples.cn: 他因那简短的回覆而感到被怠慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: slight 与 light、sight 形近；not in the slightest 是「一点也不」，a slight change 是「小改动」。

root: 可能源自古诺尔斯语 slettr（光滑、平坦）；核心义「细小平坦」，引申为「轻微」和「轻视」。

sensesIntro.en: Slight means small in degree, thin in body, or an act of treating someone as unimportant.
sensesIntro.cn: slight 意为程度轻微、身体瘦弱，或轻视某人的行为。

core.en: Small enough to be almost unnoticed.
core.cn: 小到几乎不被注意。

branches.en: A tremor is barely heard.
branches.cn: 一丝颤抖几乎听不见。

branches.en: A thin body stands at the gate.
branches.cn: 瘦小的身体站在门口。

branches.en: A short reply makes someone feel erased.
branches.cn: 简短的回覆让人感到被抹去。

branches.en: Smallness in sound and body share one word.
branches.cn: 声音与身体的「小」共用一个词。

branches.en: What is treated as small can also hurt.
branches.cn: 被当作渺小的事也可能伤人。

intro.en: Slight forms words for small amounts and small insults.
intro.cn: slight 构成表示微小数量和轻微怠慢的词。

latinIntro.en: Slight is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: slight 源自日耳曼语，并非拉丁语。

items.example: There is a slight problem.
The second shock was slighter.
I do not mind in the slightest.
The room is slightly cold.
The slightness of the frame surprised me.
A slight change improved the design.
items.exampleCN: 一个小改动改善了设计。

items.example: He suffered a slight injury.
She was not in the slightest worried.

definition_en: a little, or in a small and delicate way
core_image: 温度计的水银柱只上升了一点点
scene: 今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。The weather today is slightly warmer than yesterday.
sceneCN: 这里 slightly 是「稍微」（第 1 个义项）；句意：今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。

senses.title: To a small degree
senses.definition: a little, but not much
senses.definitionCN: 有一点，但不多
senses.example: The weather today is slightly warmer than yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。
senses.why: This is the main adverb sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是副词的主要义项。

senses.title: By a small amount
senses.definition: by a small amount or in a small way
senses.definitionCN: 以很小的量或程度
senses.example: The door was slightly open.
senses.exampleCN: 门微微开着。
senses.why: The adverb can measure a change in state.
senses.whyCN: 副词可以衡量状态的变化。

senses.title: In a slender way
senses.definition: in a thin or delicate way
senses.definitionCN: 以纤细或精巧的方式
senses.example: The bridge was slightly built.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥建得纤细。
senses.why: The old adjective sense of thin survives here.
senses.whyCN: 形容词「纤细」的古老义项在此保留。

intro.en: Slightly is slight with the adverb suffix -ly.
intro.cn: slightly 是 slight 加副词后缀 -ly。

items.en: Slettr meant smooth or level.
items.cn: slettr 意为光滑或平坦。

items.en: Slight described something thin or small.
items.cn: slight 描述细或小的东西。

items.en: Slight and -ly combined as slightly.
items.cn: slight 与 -ly 组合成 slightly。

items.en: It became the common word for a little.
items.cn: 它成为表示「一点」的常用词。

items.en: It also kept the delicate sense.
items.cn: 它也保留了纤巧的义项。

note.en: Slightly is compared with look-alike words and words for a small degree.
note.cn: 把 slightly 与形近词以及表示小程度的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Slightly is the word for a change you can barely measure.
normalIntro.cn: slightly 是形容几乎量不出的变化的词。

normal.en: The weather today is slightly warmer than yesterday.
normal.cn: 今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。

normal.en: The door was slightly open.
normal.cn: 门微微开着。

normal.en: The bridge was slightly built.
normal.cn: 这座桥建得纤细。

normal.en: Their answers were slightly different.
normal.cn: 他们的答案略有不同。

normal.en: She was slightly ahead of the others.
normal.cn: 她稍稍领先于其他人。

abstract.en: A slightly better choice repeated becomes a great difference.
abstract.cn: 稍微更好的选择重复多次，就成了巨大的差别。

abstract.en: Small changes are easy to miss and hard to undo.
abstract.cn: 微小的改变容易被忽略，却难以撤回。

abstract.en: A little can be enough if it points the right way.
abstract.cn: 只要方向对，一点点就够了。

examples.en: The weather today is slightly warmer than yesterday.
examples.cn: 今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。

examples.en: The door was slightly open.
examples.cn: 门微微开着。

examples.en: Their answers were slightly different.
examples.cn: 他们的答案略有不同。

dict_mnemonic.text: slightly = slight（轻微的）+ -ly（……地）；常用于比较级前，表示「稍微更……」。

root: 由 slight（轻微的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成；核心义「以很小的程度」。

sensesIntro.en: Slightly means a little, by a small amount, or in a delicate way.
sensesIntro.cn: slightly 意为稍微、以很小的量，或以纤细的方式。

core.en: A small degree of change.
core.cn: 很小的变化程度。

branches.en: A comparison moves by one small step.
branches.cn: 比较只移动了一小步。

branches.en: A door rests a little open.
branches.cn: 门微微开着。

branches.en: A structure stands thin and light.
branches.cn: 结构纤细轻盈地立着。

branches.en: Degree and state both change a little.
branches.cn: 程度与状态都只改变一点。

branches.en: Small in amount can also mean delicate in form.
branches.cn: 数量上的小也可以指形态上的纤巧。

intro.en: Slightly builds phrases for small differences.
intro.cn: slightly 构成表示微小差异的短语。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic; only the suffix is English.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语；后缀属英语。

items.example: The soup is slightly salty.
There is a slight delay.
The slightness of the change surprised no one.
items.exampleCN: 变化之微没人感到意外。

She feels slightly better today.
